title: Machine Lumière
style: Dark French techno, 124 BPM, distorted driving bass, punchy kick, metallic percussion, cold minimal synth stabs, filtered tension builds, spoken deep male vocal, gritty warehouse atmosphere
negativeTags: pop, country, acoustic, happy, ballad, chiptune
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Spoken) Lumière... in the machine

[Verse]
Concrete pulse beneath the floor
Steel and shadow, wanting more
Lights cut through the smoking air
Bodies moving, no one cares

[Chorus]
Machine lumière, burn it bright
Machine lumière, own the night

[Bridge]
(Spoken) Plus fort. Plus fort.
Louder. Louder.
